subject: AegisTrust renewal: evidence export, SOW and billing cadence
body:
From: Samir Ahmed <samir@aegistrust.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AegisTrust renewal proposal + evidence export for SOC2 scope

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Thanks for the pilot this year — happy to continue supporting Redwood’s SOC2 and ISO work. Attached is our renewal proposal for 2027 (12-month term) and a short CSV showing the evidence export schema we ship for clients who run audits with self-hosted tooling. Key items:
- Annual SaaS fee (base) and optional evidence retention add-on
- Support SLA: 24x6 with emergency on-call (add-on)
- Evidence export: nightly sync (S3), ad-hoc exports (CSV) or API pull (JWT)

Questions for you before we lock pricing:
1) Do you need on-prem archive export (we can provide a two-week window for pull)?
2) Is Redwood’s SOC2 scope identical to last year, or are there new systems to include?
3) Who in procurement should receive the PO vs. invoice?

Attaching: AegisTrust_Renewal_Proposal_20261103.pdf; evidence_export_schema.csv

Thanks,
Samir Ahmed
Head of Renewals, AegisTrust
samir@aegistrust.com

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Ahmed <samir@aegistrust.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AegisTrust renewal proposal + evidence export for SOC2 scope

Samir,

Appreciate the proposal — quick clarifications from our side:
- Procurement will require a finalized SOW and a line-item invoice. Finance prefers quarterly invoices; can you accommodate?
- Evidence export: we want nightly S3 export into a customer-managed bucket and the ability to pull ad-hoc snapshots for audit evidence. The CSV schema you sent looks fine but we need examples of actual exported files (sample rows).
- Retention add-on: we currently keep evidence for 18 months in-house. If your retention adds storage beyond that, we need price per GB/month.

Cc'ing Priyom (security ops) to confirm the technical export requirements. Neha — can you confirm whether this stays under the existing SOC2 scope or if we need to expand to RBAC logs?

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Samir Ahmed <samir@aegistrust.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AegisTrust renewal proposal + evidence export for SOC2 scope

Samir — quick technical notes from SecOps: 
- We require an S3 export with bucket-policy options (restrict to VPC endpoints) and server-side encryption with a KMS key (customer-managed).
- For ad-hoc exports, API tokens should be short-lived (max 8 hours).
- We need the export to include the original timestamp (UTC), evidence type, and a unique file hash. The CSV sample you sent lacks hashes — can you include an example?

Also: if you offer a VM-based evidence collector for air-gapped environments, send details (install/config, retention, and logs). We may pilot this for one high-sensitivity workload.

Thanks,
Priyom
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

On Fri, Nov 6, 2026 at 07:05 AM Samir Ahmed <samir@aegistrust.com> wrote:
> Hi Priyom — thanks for the notes. We can do customer-managed KMS encryption for S3 and provide HMAC-SHA256 file hashes for every exported artifact.
> 
> VM-based collector: available as a paid add-on; small footprint (1 vCPU, 1.5 GB RAM) and ships with a signed installer. We'll send a short install guide and a redlined SOW for the collector option.
> 
> Regarding invoices: quarterly invoicing is fine; we can send PO-friendly invoices to finance@redwood.com.
> 
> I'll attach an updated CSV (with sample rows/hashes) and a SOW draft for the collector.
> 
> Best,
> Samir

---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Ahmed <samir@aegistrust.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AegisTrust renewal proposal + evidence export for SOC2 scope

Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround and for accommodating the technical asks. A few procurement and timeline items to close this out:

Action items we need from AegisTrust by EOD Mon Nov 9:
- Finalized SOW draft (include collector appendix if we opt in) — we will review and return redlines to your legal counsel
- Updated renewal PDF with quarterly billing terms and explicit line items for the retention add-on and VM collector
- Example evidence export file with HMAC-SHA256 column and one sample artifact per evidence type
- DocuSign-ready signature page (company name: Redwood Inference, remit to: Redwood Finance, PO sent to finance@redwood.com)

Negotiation note: our budget target is a 10–12% increase over current spend for the upcoming year, given the pilot expansion. If your base renewal exceeds that, please flag where we can trade coverage (e.g., move to 18-month retention instead of 24-month) to stay in budget.

Lauren — looping you for procurement cadence and to confirm the PO process. Marissa/Priyom — once we have the SOW + evidence sample I’ll set a 30-minute review call next week to sign off from compliance and security.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Vendor Programs
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

---

Quoted attachments referenced in thread:
- AegisTrust_Renewal_Proposal_20261103.pdf (proposal & pricing table)
- evidence_export_schema.csv (sample schema; updated CSV promised)
- SOW_draft_AegisTrust_20261105.docx (collector appendix included)
